GLASS VEIL — In Silico BBB

Code and scientific diagrams: MIT; see LICENSE.txt.
PT Sans Regular and Bold: ParaType, SIL Open Font License 1.1;
see fonts/OFL-PT-Sans.txt. The logo uses outlined PT Sans lettering.

The organic cover and nature collage assets were generated with ImageGen
using visual references. Original manga pages and music tracks are not included.

frame-contour-v12.png was generated from a user-supplied anime frame.
The source frame's redistribution permission has not been documented.
This notice does not grant rights to that source frame or its character.

Calculated molecular descriptors and structural drawings are produced locally
with RDKit from registry SMILES. PubChem links identify records; the displayed
descriptor values are not a download of PubChem experimental data.
